name: Reijou Caster 2
source:
Three years after the first incident. GUIL-TV recovers from crisis and becomes a top-class broadcaster company. Five bright new casters have come to take the place of retiring star caster. 
Main character has a grudge over selfish casters. Now that he's promoted at the studio, he can finally put his revenge plan to action.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
首次事件3年后，GUIL-TV从危机中恢复，成为顶尖广播公司。5名开朗的新播音员前来接替即将退休的明星播音员。主人公对任性的播音员怀恨在心，如今升任电视台职位，终于能够实施复仇计划。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
